based_on: September 9 verified headlines on Japan physical-AI investment, yen and short-rate repricing, and the renewed oil shock
question: Kapag sabay ang bagong oportunidad at bagong panganib—AI na nangangakong babaguhin ang trabaho, habang mabilis gumagalaw ang yen, rates at oil—paano natin malalaman kung kailan sapat na ang ebidensya para kumilos at kailan mas marunong ang maghintay?

verses.text: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
